summary: RETEST frontend QR association flow after fix (iteration 16 had 'removeChild' + 'zones.find is not a function'). All 3 flows now pass with ZERO console errors and ZERO critical runtime errors.
action_items: Cleanup: delete TEST installation 'TEST_QR_RETEST' (id 29c57a30-2191-40bd-8df0-b9fb4528949a) and any associated test devices (tuya_id qrtest-t-1 / qrtest-g-1) as noted in the review request. Testing agent could not clean these via UI without side-effects.
critical_code_review_comments: QrAssociateDialog: fix is clean — the qr-reader div stays mounted (hidden via CSS) while dialog is open, preventing html5-qrcode's manual DOM removeChild from conflicting with React reconciliation.
onAssociated({res.zones}) correctly passes zones array (fixes 'zones.find is not a function' upstream in InstallationDashboard.setZones and PairingPanel onAssociated).
stopScanner is awaited before switching to manual, so no orphaned MediaStream.
test_credentials: installateur@demo.fr / Demo1234! (used). Admin creds not needed for QR flow.
seed_data_creation: Created installation 'TEST_QR_RETEST' (id 29c57a30-2191-40bd-8df0-b9fb4528949a) with zones Salon (master) + Chambre. Associated CZ-QRTEST01 to existing zone (Salon) and CZ-QRTEST02 to a new zone 'TEST_QR_NouvelleZone' (backend rattaches gainable to master zone).
context_for_next_testing_agent: QR association flow fully validated. Flows tested: (1) CZ-QRTEST01 manual entry → existing zone Salon → success, dialog closes. (2) CZ-QRTEST02 → new zone 'TEST_QR_NouvelleZone' → success, dialog closes (backend rattaches gainable to master). (3) 4x open/close cycles alternating manual/camera → zero errors. Console captured 0 errors, 0 warnings across the entire session.
rca of the issue: Previous 'removeChild' error was caused by html5-qrcode manipulating a DOM node that React had already unmounted (React tried to remove a child that html5-qrcode had detached). Fix: keep the #qr-reader-region div always mounted while dialog is open (toggle via CSS 'hidden' class instead of conditional render). Previous 'zones.find is not a function' was caused by onAssociated receiving the full API response object; fix passes res.zones (array) explicitly. Both issues are now resolved.
